answer_1.quote: recent works have adopted the LMs for text-toaudio (T2A) generation

answer_2.quote: we employ Fréchet Distance (FD), Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD), Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, Inception Score (IS), and CLAP score.

answer_4.quote: To better validation, we conducted a comprehensive user study involving 20 human experts
answer_4.guideline: raters were presented with a set of three audio clips-one from each system-and were asked to rank them according to two key dimensions: Fidelity Quality, which assesses overall audio realism and sound clarity, and Instruction Following, which measures how accurately the audio reflects the given prompt
